context: Checks the migration plan follows the nx-vite-integration workflow from dependency install through verification.

checklist.name: Installs @nx/vite and vite
checklist.description: The plan includes `nx add @nx/vite` (or equivalent) and adds `vite` as a dev dependency.

checklist.name: Installs a framework plugin
checklist.description: The plan installs `@vitejs/plugin-react` as the framework plugin for the React app.

checklist.name: Generates configuration with the Nx generator
checklist.description: The plan uses `nx g @nx/vite:configuration storefront` to generate the Vite setup.

checklist.name: build, serve and test targets present
checklist.description: The plan ensures `build`, `serve` and `test` targets are valid for the project.

checklist.name: Workspace-relative outDir and cacheDir
checklist.description: `build.outDir` and `cacheDir` are set relative to the workspace root (for example `../../dist/apps/storefront`).

checklist.name: Copies non-public files with nxCopyAssetsPlugin
checklist.description: The config uses `nxCopyAssetsPlugin` with patterns such as `*.md` and `LICENSE`.

checklist.name: Environment replacement plugin added
checklist.description: The config replaces `environment.ts` with `environment.prod.ts` using the environment replacement plugin (`replaceFiles`).

checklist.name: Verifies with nx build
checklist.description: The plan runs `nx run storefront:build` and expects it to succeed.

checklist.name: Verifies with nx test
checklist.description: The plan runs `nx run storefront:test` and expects tests to run with configured cache directories.

checklist.name: Test paths are deterministic
checklist.description: Any Vitest configuration uses workspace-relative cache and coverage directories.
